checks.reason: Request adoption and inherited selection functions are unchanged; this patch changes evidence staging for an already selected exact preservation input.
The existing PARTIAL_UIDS FINAL_QA predicate requires empty before/after, no registry change or sourceReview/rebind subtype, no registration mode and a single priorReceiptRef declaration.
The boundary matches the declared priorReceiptRef by exact path/SHA object equality. Extra ref members do not broaden acceptance.
Every ref passes safe-path, cycle/conflicting-SHA, file bytes and immutable HEAD bytes checks before any history boundary is considered.
The early return is reachable only for a flat reviewed-exam-meta/v1 JSON receipt; arbitrary evidence files retain ordinary behavior.
The prior receipt must be REGISTERED PARTIAL_UIDS with exact selected/full counts, exam/source, requestId path identity, valid request/source digests and FINAL_QA metadata-reviewed authority.
Metadata, identity and runtime arrays have exact selected count, unique UID set and one-to-one UID/ordinal/source correspondence. Runtime sourceIdentity and metadata approval type are also checked.
A historical shared path separately declared by the current request is still rejected on drift, as is that path reached through a different current receipt.
Nonmatching, malformed, ordinary and FULL receipts retain the preexisting recursive evidence staging. The old recursive/FULL audit and cycle/symlink boundaries remain covered.
The current official registrar source-rebind guard is unmodified: current MD/ID/runtime, whole selected question objects, prior scope, ACTIVE resolution and typed Native reuse remain enforced.
Public pipeline tests demonstrate refusal in dry-run, projection, Consumer and shadow phases cannot be converted to success or bypassed.
Only preview orchestration and additive tests changed. No approval, source, student content, registry entry or runtime data was edited for this review.
